name: Platformer HUD
description:
[b]Platformer HUD Template[/b]
A side-scrolling platformer game HUD with:
• Health hearts display
• Coin counter
• Level indicator
• Timer display
code:
' Platformer HUD
Dim coins As Integer
Dim timeLeft As Integer
Dim maxHearts As Integer
Dim currentHearts As Integer

Sub Form_Load()
    coins = 0
    timeLeft = 300
    maxHearts = 3
    currentHearts = 3
    UpdateDisplay()
End Sub

Sub UpdateDisplay()
    lblCoins.Text = "x " & coins
    lblTime.Text = "TIME: " & timeLeft
End Sub

Sub AddCoin()
    coins = coins + 1
    UpdateDisplay()
    If coins >= 100 Then
        coins = 0
        ' Extra life!
    End If
End Sub
